hero.title: Azure Cloud Migration
hero.tagline: Migration of on-premises monolithic servers to 500+ Azure Cloud Microservices

snippets.title: Kubernetes Deployment
snippets.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api-service
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: acr.azurecr.io/api-service:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "256Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
          limits:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "500m"
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
        env:
        - name: REDIS_HOST
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: redis-config
              key: host

frontend.name: Service Mesh Configuration
frontend.code:
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: api-gateway
spec:
  hosts:
  - api.company.com
  gateways:
  - api-gateway
  http:
  - match:
    - uri:
        prefix: /api/v1
    route:
    - destination:
        host: api-service
        port:
          number: 8080
      weight: 90
    - destination:
        host: api-service-canary
        port:
          number: 8080
      weight: 10
    timeout: 30s
    retries:
      attempts: 3
      perTryTimeout: 10s

devops.name: CI/CD Pipeline
devops.code:
# azure-pipelines.yml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - develop

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

variables:
  dockerRegistry: 'company.azurecr.io'
  imageName: 'api-service'
  kubernetesCluster: 'company-aks-prod'

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - job: BuildAndPush
    steps:
    - task: Docker@2
      inputs:
        command: buildAndPush
        repository: $(imageName)
        dockerfile: Dockerfile
        containerRegistry: $(dockerRegistry)
        tags: |
          $(Build.BuildId)
          latest

- stage: Deploy
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployToAKS
    environment: 'production'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: KubernetesManifest@0
            inputs:
              action: deploy
              manifests: |
                k8s/deployment.yaml
                k8s/service.yaml
              containers: |
                $(dockerRegistry)/$(imageName):$(Build.BuildId)
